primaryChecks.text: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.
primaryChecks.previousContext: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.
